fixtures.preview: United host Bournemouth on Sunday, three days after a 4-1 Champions League defeat at Como, with Michael Carrick under pressure.
talking_points: The Como loss extended United's winless run to seven games in all competitions, and they have 3 points from 3 Champions League games.
Carrick is reported to be staying in charge for Sunday despite the pressure.
Lisandro Martínez (thigh) is a doubt after going off against Leeds; Carrick has played it down as 'not that bad'.
Kobbie Mainoo is about ten more days away, Luke Shaw is out longer, Rashford has a hip problem and Ayden Heaven is ill; Matthijs de Ligt is fit again.

fixtures.preview: A 12:30pm UK trip to Stamford Bridge on Saturday 31 October.
Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford, with United on 3 points from 3 games.
A Sunday 4:30pm UK home game against Aston Villa, picked for TV.
The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time, live on Sky Sports in the UK.
A Sunday 3pm home game, part of a double-header with Sydney FC Women v Melbourne City at 5:45pm.
talking_points: Sydney opened with a 0-0 derby draw against Western Sydney, and coach Patrick Kisnorbo called the effort a foundation to build on.
Adelaide kick off at 2:30pm local time (3pm Sydney); I couldn't find their form or team news for Sunday.
Sydney's Australia Cup run ended with a 0-2 semi-final loss to Melbourne Victory on 9 September.

fixtures.preview: A 5pm Halloween game at AAMI Park, Melbourne City's home opener.
A Friday-night home game against the Mariners (round 4).
An away trip to Brisbane Roar at Kayo Stadium, 6:40pm Brisbane time (7:40pm Sydney).
The Big Blue at Allianz Stadium on Sunday 6 December at 5pm, per the club's ticket page.

big_matches.title: Barcelona v Real Madrid (El Clásico)
big_matches.why: First Clásico of the season at Camp Nou, with José Mourinho now in charge of Real Madrid.
talking_points: Barcelona lost 4-2 at PSG on Tuesday in the Champions League.
Real Madrid beat Leipzig 4-1 on Wednesday, so they arrive in better form.
Hansi Flick's Barcelona host Mourinho's Madrid.

big_matches.title: Liverpool v Arsenal
big_matches.why: A heavyweight clash at Anfield, moved to Sunday 4:30pm UK time for TV.
talking_points: Liverpool beat Villarreal 4-3 in the Champions League on Tuesday.
Arsenal drew 2-2 at Bayern on Wednesday.

big_matches.title: Atlético Madrid v Bayern Munich
big_matches.why: Two European heavyweights meet on matchday 4 in Madrid.
talking_points: Atlético drew 1-1 at Stuttgart on matchday 3.
Bayern drew 2-2 at home to Arsenal on matchday 3.

big_matches.title: Barcelona v Aston Villa
big_matches.why: Barcelona need a response after their 4-2 loss at PSG.
talking_points: Aston Villa beat Viking 3-1 on matchday 3, so they arrive in form.
Barcelona play this at home, a week after the Clásico.

notes: Searches were thin and many sites blocked access (HTTP 403), so several sections are shorter than their limits rather than padded.

Man Utd: team news (Martínez doubtful, Mainoo and Shaw out, Carrick expected to stay) comes from search summaries of Livescore and other reporting; I couldn't open manutd.com. The Premier League fixture list shows Sky/TNT as UK broadcasters, and Stan Sport as the Australian broadcaster is assumed from its Premier League rights. United v Brentford on 28 Nov has no time yet.

Sydney FC: kick-off times for 25 Oct, 6 Nov and 6 Dec are from the club's ticket page; the Melbourne City (31 Oct) and Brisbane (21 Nov) times weren't re-checked. Paramount+ is assumed as the A-Leagues broadcaster.
Big matches: I couldn't confirm the Australian broadcaster for El Clásico (beIN is likely but its page didn't list the match), so broadcast is blank. Wallabies November Tests had no confirmed times.
Live sport: Kings start times aren't published on the venue page. No rugby union or tennis in Sydney in the next 4 weeks was found.

Local: school events come from the downloaded Term 4 calendars and Week 2 updates; no local news from the past 7 days was found beyond the street-works note. The other school's public site had no events.
Not found: matcha pop-ups in Sydney, junior parkrun or kids' fun runs near home, Pokémon/Minecraft/Roblox events, kids' ticket deals and football-boot sales with confirmed dates.
Groceries: Woolworths and Coles half-price lists were not accessible, so most prices have no was-price. The Aldi tuna price is from the catalogue running to 30 Nov.
Horizon: entries were carried over; I couldn't re-open the Rugby World Cup ticket page this run, so check the official site for what's still on sale.
Deals: expired freebies from the last run were dropped; the Pitt Street Mall coffee giveaway couldn't be re-confirmed.
